$Comment: The library's sample track, switched off: nothing on a server grows it until the owner turns it on in mods/ziggfreedcommon/tracks.json with { "Zc_Track_Example": { "Enabled": true } }. Then /zigtrack add --track=Zc_Track_Example --amount=1000 climbs it, and each level an Unlocks row names parks a Claim on the player's Claims tab: three copper bars at levels 2 and 5, a blue crystal at every fourth level. It prestiges three times, first at level 12, and stops at level 15.
